title: Seat an old-work electrical box in a drywall cutout and lock both swing-out clamps
instruction: Seat the old-work electrical box flush in the drywall cutout, then swing and seat both orange mounting clamps flat across the rear drywall flanges.
context: Installing remodel (old-work) electrical junction boxes into drywall openings is routine residential and commercial electrical work (electricians, O*NET 47-2111.00): the box body is seated flush inside the cutout opening first, and top and bottom swing-out mounting clamps are then deployed flat across the rear drywall flanges to lock the box in place. Because each mounting clamp bridges the drywall flange and the electrical box top face, its level seat exists only once the box is seated flush. A clamp laid into a lock pocket before the box is seated tips about 23.4 degrees into the empty cutout, and a box left cocked on the 5 mm cutout collar tilts the clamp past 3 degrees.
setup: Table coordinates in metres: x forward from the line through the two arm bases, y left from the midline, z up from the table top; the arm bases are at y = +0.305 (left) and y = -0.305 (right). The drywall cutout centre F is (0.250, 0.000), on the midline. Loose, rigid, matte: the old-work electrical box (box), a blue PVC (sRGB 0.14, 0.42, 0.78) block 100 x 60 x 16 mm, 95 g (printed PLA), lying flat centred at (0.220, 0.320) with its long axis along y; two swing-out mounting clamps, orange (sRGB 0.95, 0.52, 0.08) blocks 60 x 16 x 16 mm, 10 g each (printed PLA), lying along x in their stowed keyways on the outer flanges, clamp_plus centred at (0.250, +0.103) and clamp_minus at (0.250, -0.103), bottoms 16 mm above the table. Fixed, matte, 18 blocks in all, forming one drywall cutout wall frame: a cutout collar ring 5 mm tall standing on the table, two side walls 126 x 10 x 5 mm centred at (0.250, +0.038) and (0.250, -0.038) and two end walls 10 x 66 x 5 mm centred at (0.192, 0.000) and (0.308, 0.000), giving an open cutout pocket 106 x 66 mm whose floor is the table (3 mm clearance per side around the electrical box); two drywall mounting flanges (sRGB 0.76, 0.74, 0.69) 160 x 80 x 16 mm centred at (0.250, +0.083) and (0.250, -0.083), spanning 43 to 123 mm either side of the midline against the collar ring's outer faces, their tops 16 mm above the table and flush with a seated electrical box's top; on each flange, a stowed keyway of four steel-grey ribs (sRGB 0.36, 0.39, 0.43) 10 x 4 x 10 mm centred at x 0.223 and 0.277 and y +-0.091 and +-0.115 (20 mm inner gap, flanking the last 8 mm at each end of the stowed clamp); on the left flange, an upstream clamp-lock pocket of two ribs 4 x 10 x 10 mm centred at x 0.207 and 0.237 and y +0.061 (slot centre x = 0.222), and on the right flange, a downstream clamp-lock pocket of two ribs 4 x 10 x 10 mm centred at x 0.263 and 0.293 and y -0.061 (slot centre x = 0.278), their inner faces 26 mm apart, spanning 56 to 66 mm from the midline, tops 26 mm above the table. Nominal end state: the electrical box centred on F with its long axis along x, flat on the table inside the cutout pocket, top flush with the drywall flanges; clamp_plus along y centred at (0.222, +0.036) and clamp_minus along y centred at (0.278, -0.036), each spanning 6 to 66 mm from the midline: 24 mm on the electrical box, 13 mm across the 3 mm cutout gap and 10 mm collar wall, and 23 mm on the drywall flange with its outer 10 mm between the lock ribs.
scoring: End state only, judged after the arms have withdrawn and all bodies are at rest (linear speed under 10 mm/s and angular speed under 0.5 rad/s). Electrical box seated (P): at rest with its centre within 4 mm of F in x and y, long axis within 3 degrees of x either way round, all four bottom corners within 2 mm of the table and all four top corners within 2 mm of the drywall flange tops (16 mm up). A mounting clamp is locked in an offset pocket when it rests with its long axis within 10 degrees of y either way round, a face within 3 degrees of flat, its lowest corner within 2 mm of the flange tops (16 mm up), its centre within 4 mm of the pocket centre line across the slot (x = 0.222 left upstream, x = 0.278 right downstream), its outer end within 4 mm of the lock ribs' outer faces (66 mm from the midline), and its inner end at least 18 mm onto the electrical box top face. Either clamp may fill either offset pocket and each pocket counts once. Score: 0.0 without P, regardless of clamp positions; P alone 0.4; P and one offset clamp pocket locked 0.7; P and both offset clamp pockets locked 1.0. Success, which ends the trial, is the 1.0 condition held continuously for 1.0 s.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. Lift the electrical box out and lay it flat on its start mark at (0.220, 0.320), long axis along y; lay each orange mounting clamp back in its keyway along x at (0.250, +-0.103). The drywall frame does not move; check it against its taped outline.
fidelity: Approximate: rigid box primitives with shared friction and matte colours; the cutout collar ring, drywall flanges, and ribs are fixed colliders standing in for one printed drywall cutout frame. A real old-work electrical box rotates plastic ears via #6-32 machine screws; here the electrical box seats flush in a cutout opening and loose swing-out clamps bridge across the joint into staggered lock pockets under gravity. Earth gravity on a bench.
